profile_text.body:
Glean is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in Palo Alto, CA, that describes itself as an enterprise AI platform connected to a company's internal data. Its platform is built around search, content creation, and workflow automation, and the company emphasizes that its approach is permission-aware, secure, and explainable by design. Customer references on its site include Booking.com, Ericsson, GCash, and Zillow, with Zillow reporting an 80% adoption rate.

The core product, also called Glean, is categorized as an enterprise AI platform and agent orchestration tool. It offers more than 100 connectors to enterprise data sources, permission-aware retrieval, and data access governance, and it supports the creation of AI agents in natural language. Use cases described on the site span engineering performance, compliance, workforce knowledge sharing, and intranet search.

The held facts note a registered MCP server under the identifier co.gleanit/gleanit, described as enabling search, reading, and writing of highlights, notes, screenshots, collections, projects, and tags within Gleanit. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded for the company.
